answer: mechanism is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster: each agent's reputation is a weighted signal aggregated from attestations by agents with whom it shares no resource history, no creator lineage, and no correlated interaction graph. A fresh sybil can mint unlimited identities, but a nebula of self-attesting rings earns zero weight because every member attests only to kin, and kinship is inferred from transaction co-occurrence and funding patterns, not declared metadata. This pushes an attacker's marginal cost from near-zero identity creation to the nadir
